annotations.title: Save (or unsave) a registry listing to your favorites

description: Save any registry listing (skill / harness / rig) you didn't author to your Favorites, to find and run later. A favorite is a POINTER (find provider_id + external_id via registry_search); running or scheduling it adopts a runner-owned copy on demand. Pass remove:true to unsave. Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.
